| **Static FileWrites** | `FileWrites` in static ItemGroup not consumed properly | Moved inside `IncludeGeneratedProtoCode` target |
| **Lost files on incremental** | `<Compile Include>` inside skipped target never runs | Split into always-running `IncludeGeneratedProtoCode` target with `DependsOnTargets="GenerateProtoCode"` |
